title: StyleAT: Defending Face Recognition Against Semantic Attacks
abstract: arXiv:2609.23596v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: With face-recognition models now embedded in everyday authentication and surveillance, recent works have pinpointed a critical weakness: these models remain acutely vulnerable to adversarial semantic edits. I.e., adversarially produced semantic alterations to the input, such as slight aging or pose changes, can induce misclassifications. Certain existing attacks are powerful, but they can be computationally costly, rendering them inadequate for developing defenses (e.g., through adversarial training). To fill the gap, we introduce BoundStyle, a potent semantic attack operating in StyleGAN's rich latent space to maximize misclassification rates. translated_title: StyleAT：防御人脸识别免受语义攻击
translated_abstract: 随着人脸识别模型如今被广泛应用于日常身份验证和监控系统中，近期研究指出了一个关键弱点：这些模型对对抗性语义编辑仍然极其脆弱。也就是说，对输入进行对抗性生成的语义改变，例如轻微的年龄变化或姿态变化，可以诱导模型产生误分类。某些现有攻击方法虽然强大，但计算成本高昂，使其难以用于开发防御手段（例如通过对抗训练）。为填补这一空白，我们提出了BoundStyle，一种在StyleGAN丰富潜在空间中运行的强大语义攻击方法，旨在最大化误分类率。值得注意的是，BoundStyle在实现高攻击成功率的同时，比现有最先进的攻击方法快约9.5倍，使其适用于对抗训练。基于BoundStyle，我们进一步开发了StyleAT，一种结合低预算攻击的高效对抗训练方案。
tldr: 提出了基于StyleGAN潜在空间的高效语义攻击方法BoundStyle（比现有最先进攻击快约9.5倍），并在此基础上构建了高效的对抗训练方案StyleAT，用于防御人脸识别模型免受语义攻击。
en_tdlr: We introduce BoundStyle, a potent semantic attack in StyleGAN's latent space that is ~9.5x faster than state-of-the-art attacks, and build StyleAT, an efficient adversarial training scheme to defend face recognition models against semantic attacks.
